details.description: Loading placeholders use fixed light colors (`bg-gray-300`) which become invisible or low-contrast in dark mode.
details.fix_explanation: Make placeholder bar colors conditional on `darkMode` and reuse `cardClasses` so placeholders remain visible in both modes.

details.description: Metric label and value colors are not adjusted for dark mode; label uses `text-gray-500` which reduces contrast in dark mode.
details.fix_explanation: Use conditional classes for label and value colors based on `darkMode` so text remains readable in both themes.

details.description: Cards use `bg-white` in light mode which matches the page background, causing poor visual separation.
details.fix_explanation: Introduce `cardClasses` with `bg-gray-50` (light) and `bg-gray-800` (dark) plus borders to create clear separation in both modes.
details.after: const cardClasses = darkMode ? "bg-gray-800 border border-gray-700" : "bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200";

details.description: No empty-state view when metrics array is empty after loading — the grid is blank and provides no feedback.
details.fix_explanation: Add a simple `No metrics available` empty state card that respects theme styling and is testable via `data-testid="empty-state"`.

details.description: Dark mode toggle lacks `aria-label` and strong focus styles making keyboard interaction less discoverable.
details.fix_explanation: Add `aria-label` and improved focus ring (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500`) and persist preference to localStorage on toggle.
details.after: <button ... aria-label={...} className={... focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 ...} onClick={() => { setDarkMode(!darkMode); localStorage.setItem('dashboard-dark', String(!darkMode)); }}>...

details.description: Using `m.label` as the React key works for now but may break if labels are not unique.
details.fix_explanation: Prefer a stable unique id when available; leave as-is but flag as a potential future improvement.
details.after: <article key={m.label} ...> (consider switching to a unique `id` property when available)
